people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

translations.web: Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers;
translations.bsb: In this way God repaid the wickedness that Abimelech had done to his father in murdering his seventy brothers.
translations.kjv: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:
